name: Sovrium Hello World
description: The one-page starter: the first page after sovrium init.

BUILDPACK_URL.description: Sovrium buildpack — downloads the released, checksum-verified sovrium binary and boots the app config (Scalingo does not build Dockerfiles).

SOVRIUM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Master key for encrypting stored credentials at rest (AES-256-GCM). Optional — the app generates and persists one on first start if unset. Keep it set here: the container filesystem is ephemeral, so a generated key would not survive a restart.

BASE_URL.description: Public https address of this app (e.g. https://my-hello-world.osc-fr1.scalingo.io). Used for auth callbacks and absolute links. Never a localhost address: Sovrium would treat the app as local and turn off its cross-site request check and its Secure cookie flag.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.description: How many proxies stand in front of the app. 1 trusts Scalingo's router to report each visitor's address, so sign-in and API rate limits count per visitor instead of putting every request on the router's address. Raise it only if you add your own CDN in front of Scalingo.
